title: The 3 Most Important Supplements For Men
hook: These are the three most important supplements for men. If you take nothing else, take these.
body:
Number one, fish oil. If you only take one supplement, make it this one. Heart, joints, recovery, skin and hair. It's the most proven supplement there is, and most men eat almost no fish.

Number two, vitamin D. About 70% of people are deficient. Fixing it raises your testosterone, your immunity and your workout performance. I take 5,000 IU a day in liquid form. It's cheaper and easier to dose.

Number three, magnesium. Take this one at night. It improves your sleep, and your sleep decides whether you build muscle and control your appetite the next day.

Here's what nobody selling you supplements will say: they're about 5% of your results. Your nutrition, your training and your sleep matter far more. Three supplements taken daily beats a stack of ten you never take.
